title: Catalogue the native select (class .select) and give the authority assignment vocabulary
problem: Downstream agents (4 independent runs) needed a compact single-select for a small fixed set and could not cite any canon: the styled native <select> exists in Triage (CSS + examples + a Forms demos) but is not catalogued, has no aliases, and the resolver mis-routes assignment phrasings to pattern/detail or composes unrelated recipes.
evidence: all four runs fell back to fallback/native-control with a token-conformant native <select> and marked TODO(authority-undefined)
baseline resolves: 4/8 picker phrasings mis-resolve to pattern/detail; 'assign'/'owner'/'reviewer' have zero search hits (docs/evolution/data/baseline-resolves-0.12.1.json)
existing_authority_considered: component/cb - filterable listbox; wrong tool for 4 fixed names (drags listbox JS into a no-JS case)
component/radio - fine for always-visible small choice, not a compact inline assign control
fallback/native-control - already the sanctioned shape, but a fallback is the wrong home for a first-class recurring need
why_insufficient: The visual layer already exists (core/base.css styles select including focus, aria-invalid, phone ergonomics) and every downstream run chose it; what is missing is addressability: no spec entry, no class contract, no aliases, resolver returns mis-routes or UNDEFINED. The need recurred in 4/4 evidence runs - systemic, not project-local.

triage_snapshot: src/core/base.css: add .select as an explicit class alias to the existing select rules (shared control rule, focus rule, phone font-size + 44px min-height, aria-invalid rules). Additive selector aliases only - no new declarations, no new visual language.

spec/states.json: add component { class: 'select', name: 'Select (native)', source: 'base.css', status: 'beta', states: ['default','focus','invalid','disabled'], verify: ['.select','.select:focus','.select[aria-invalid="true"]'], a11y: [native semantics + visible label; keyboard is the platform's; 16px on phone to prevent iOS zoom; 44px min touch target (already in base.css); never replace with a JS listbox for small fixed sets] }
site/pages_components.py: show class="select" in the Forms select demo + a11y note.
VERSION + package.json + spec/rules.json + spec/states.json(version) + rename-map.json -> 0.13.0-experiment; CHANGELOG entry.
curation: aliases.json: component/select -> ['select','native select','single select','select control','assign picker','owner picker','reviewer picker','fixed list picker']
component-notes.json: component/select summary ('Native single-select for small fixed option sets; class .select for explicit citation; component/cb is the large/filtered-set option')

not_proposed: component/select as a new visual component (c3 proposal) - nothing new to build; REVISE down to documentation
recipe/entity-picker on component/cb (c1 proposal) - wrong ingredient for small fixed sets; kept as guidance inside the recipe instead
compatibility: Additive: bare <select> keeps identical styling; new class alias only. No existing selector semantics altered. No breakage risk for existing implementations (c1-c4 fallbacks remain valid markup).
validation: triage: python3 build.py check (core sync, DTCG, verify.py states matrix with 37 components, strict lint 100/100)
authority: pack rebuild parity, golden set + new convergence cases
convergence: the 8 baseline picker phrasings must land on one sanctioned answer (recipe/assign-picker) with no pattern/detail mis-routes
migration: Existing implementations using a token-styled native select are already conformant; add class="select" for explicit citation on next touch, or keep the bare element (visually identical). The downstream TODO(authority-undefined) markers can be replaced with a citation of recipe/assign-picker.
